text:
meera: Quick status check on console observability roadmap — dashboards, trace hooks, error-analysis views, and the 90d retention milestone. Who owns what and any blockers?

alex: I own dashboard UI. Most panels wired up but waiting on final metrics contract from infra (span tags + naming).

infra-bot: deploy: metrics-api v2 deployed to staging at 1825005000 :rocket:

ryan: Infra here — posted metrics contract: https://internal.specs/redwood/metrics-v2. Missing one tag: `request.source` for tenant routing. PR open: infra#412.

alex: That was the blocker for histogram + p95 by tenant. @olivia can you confirm error bucket field names so we can wire panels?

olivia: Confirming naming: `error.type` + `error.code`. Also want `service.role` for multi-tenant splits. I'll update the spec by EOD today.

meera: Trace hooks status? @ryan any ETA on the instrumentation lib patch landing?

ryan: Instrumentation lib PR is in review: https://code/repo/pr/89. Waiting on one SRE review for perf impact. @sre-lead can you take a look today?

sre-lead: On it. Will run perf tests and check for race conditions. If green, approve by 3pm PT.

alex: Retention note: Ops requested 90d for traces but finance flagged storage cost. Proposal: keep full spans for 14d, roll up detailed spans (histograms/aggregates) and keep trace metadata for 90d.

meera: Sounds reasonable. Product/analytics sign-off required for roll-up fidelity. @olivia?

olivia: Product is ok with roll-up as long as error-analysis can fetch raw spans for flagged traces (archival pull). Can we add an archival-fetch prototype to next sprint?

ryan: Archival prototype blocked by S3 creds for customer buckets. Infra will schedule a short onboarding task (credentials + vault access). ETA Wed.

alex: Action items: Alex -> finish panel mapping and add queries once `request.source` tag lands. Ryan -> finish span tag PR + set up archival creds. Olivia -> finalize naming + add product acceptance criteria. SRE -> review perf PR. I'll open a tracking ticket and assign owners.

meera: Please update the ticket with PR links and set milestone `obs-90d-retention` before EOD. If any blocker remains after Wednesday, ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ticket created: OPS-1873 "console obs: dashboards + trace hooks + retention plan" assigned to alex/ryan/olivia/sre-lead.

alex: copying here the dash stub for review: ```
{
  "panels": ["latency_p95","errors_by_type","trace_volume"]
}
```

olivia: ACK, will review the queries and add acceptance tests.

meera: Thanks everyone — short async check worked. Will re-run sync on Thursday if needed.
